name: Lamps and Ladders
tagline: Flight Console with instruments that carry real light: a jewelled pilot lamp for everything that is on, a T-minus lamp ladder counting down to each hop, one four-shape lamp code with its key, and a moving-coil panel meter on Status.
concept: Flight Console with instruments that carry real light. Jewelled pilot lamps mark what is on. T-minus lamp ladders count down to each hop and to Next up, and the setup countdown is a ladder whose amber segments sit level with the steps still to do, over a dark Ready. One four-shape lamp code, with a key, runs every page, and a moving-coil panel meter reads the day's spend above the fold on Status: a needle under a dark skirt, a lit limit index and a drag pointer at the 30-day average. The console is slate, steel and Plex, the flight plan is solid violet line numbered the same on every page, and #6dff9c is light on a short list.
companions: Slate (#111716) for every bay under one 2px top rule. Steel (#6f8596 with a #a9c4d8 cap) for 'here', today, the waiting dot and the family's side of the log. Pewter rings for off, and for a plan already flown. Amber (#e3a651) only for needs a look and late, as a bar, an edge or words, never a surface. Violet (#a191bd) only as solid flight-plan lines and stop rings. Matte kind swatches.
